```js
function placeSlat(m, s){
  s = ((s % LOOP) + LOOP) % LOOP;
  if (s < 2*Lh){ m.position.set(0, RY+R, Lh - s); m.rotation.set(0,0,0); }
```

```js
function drawGauge(speed, mode){

  const cx=128, cy=92, r=58;
  const a0=Math.PI*0.75, a1=Math.PI*2.25;
  gx.lineCap='round';
  gx.beginPath(); gx.arc(cx,cy,r,a0,a1); gx.strokeStyle='#272d34'; gx.lineWidth=9; gx.stroke();
  const tv=Math.min(speed/4,1);
  if(tv>0.002){ gx.beginPath(); gx.arc(cx,cy,r,a0,a0+(a1-a0)*tv); gx.strokeStyle= speed>2.2 ? '#ff7a3d' : '#ffb454'; gx.lineWidth=9; gx.stroke(); }
  // ticks

    const r1=r-11, r2=maj? r-19 : r-15;
```

```js
function pose(){
  const p = gaitPhase;
  const s = Math.sin(p), s2 = Math.sin(2*p);
  const breathe = Math.sin(simT*1.5);
  // legs
  setLeg(legL, p);
  setLeg(legR, p+Math.PI);
  // arms
  armL.sh.rotation.set(P.arm*s + 0.012*breathe*wIdle, 0, -P.splay);
  armR.sh.rotation.set(-P.arm*s + 0.012*breathe*wIdle, 0, P.splay);
  armL.el.rotation.x = -(P.elbowB + P.elbowP*Math.max(0,-s));
  armR.el.rotation.x = -(P.elbowB + P.elbowP*Math.max(0, s));
  // spine / hips / head
  spine.rotation.x = P.lean + 0.014*breathe*wIdle;
  spine.rotation.y = P.spineTw*s;
  hips.rotation.y = -P.hipTw*s;
  headG.rotation.x = -P.lean*0.55;
  headG.rotation.y = -P.spineTw*0.6*s;
  // root
  root.position.y = BELT_TOP + bobK*s2 + 0.005*breathe*wIdle;
  root.position.x = P.sway*Math.cos(p);
}
function setLeg(L, ph){
  const sn = Math.sin(ph);
  const thigh = -P.thigh*sn;
  const knee = P.kneeSw*Math.max(0, Math.sin(ph+2.4)) + P.kneeSt*Math.max(0, Math.sin((ph - Math.PI/2)*1.2));
  const foot = -0.62*(thigh+knee) + P.toe*Math.max(0, Math.sin(ph-3.1)) - P.heel*Math.max(0, Math.sin((ph-0.85)*2.0));
  L.hip.rotation.x = thigh;
  L.knee.rotation.x = knee;
  L.ankle.rotation.x = foot;
}
```

```js
const KNOTS = [0, Math.PI/2, Math.PI, 3*Math.PI/2, 5.45, Math.PI*2];
function sampleKeys(knotVals, ph){
  let x = ((ph % TAU) + TAU) % TAU;
  for(let i=0;i<KNOTS.length-1;i++){
    if(x <= KNOTS[i+1] + 1e-6){
      const u = (x - KNOTS[i]) / (KNOTS[i+1] - KNOTS[i]);
      return knotVals[i] + (knotVals[i+1]-knotVals[i]) * smoother(u);
    }
  }
  return knotVals[KNOTS.length-1];
}
function smoother(u){ u=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,u)); return u*u*u*(u*(u*6-15)+10); }
```

```js
    let s = (i*SPACING + beltOffset) % LOOP; if(s<0) s+=LOOP;
    const m = slats[i];
    if(s < 2*Lh){ m.position.set(0, RY+R, Lh - s); m.rotation.set(0,0,0); }
    else if(s < 2*Lh + Math.PI*R){ const t=(s-2*Lh)/R; m.position.set(0, RY+R*Math.cos(t), -Lh - R*Math.sin(t)); m.rotation.set(-t,0,0); }
    else if(s < 4*Lh + Math.PI*R){ m.position.set(0, RY-R, -Lh + (s-2*Lh-Math.PI*R)); m.rotation.set(Math.PI,0,0); }
    else { const t=(s-4*Lh-Math.PI*R)/R; m.position.set(0, RY-R*Math.cos(t), Lh + R*Math.sin(t)); m.rotation.set(Math.PI-t,0,0); }
  }
}
```

Blend & weights:

```js
function ss(e0,e1,x){ const u=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(x-e0)/(e1-e0))); return u*u*(3-2*u); }
const KEYS_N = 6;
const kK = new Array(6), kF = new Array(6);
const P = {};
function computeWeights(t){
  const wW = ss(2,2.5,t)*(1-ss(5,5.5,t));
  const wR = ss(5,5.5,t)*(1-ss(8,8.5,t));
  return { wI: 1-wW-wR, wW, wR };
}
function blend(w){
  const a=GAIT.idle, b=GAIT.walk, c=GAIT.run;
  for(const k in a){
    if(k==='knee'||k==='foot') continue;
    P[k] = a[k]*w.wI + b[k]*w.wW + c[k]*w.wR;
  }
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
    kK[i] = a.knee[i]*w.wI + b.knee[i]*w.wW + c.knee[i]*w.wR;
    kF[i] = a.foot[i]*w.wI + b.foot[i]*w.wW + c.foot[i]*w.wR;
  }
}
```

sampleKeys with knots [0, π/2, π, 3π/2, 5.45, 2π]:

```js
const KNOT = [0, Math.PI/2, Math.PI, 3*Math.PI/2, 5.45, Math.PI*2];
function smoother(u){ u=u<0?0:u>1?1:u; return u*u*u*(u*(6*u-15)+10); }
function sampleKeys(vals, ph){
  let x = ph % TAU; if(x<0) x+=TAU; if(x>TAU) x=TAU;
  let i=0; while(i<4 && x>KNOT[i+1]) i++;
  const u=(x-KNOT[i])/(KNOT[i+1]-KNOT[i]);
  return vals[i]+(vals[i+1]-vals[i])*smoother(u);
}
```

Main loop:

```js
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
let simT = 0, gaitPhase = 0, gaugeAcc = 1;
const hud = { mode: document.getElementById('mode'), spd: document.getElementById('spd'), fill: document.getElementById('fill') };
let hudMode = '', hudSpd = '';
const colIdle = '#596068', colWalk = '#ffb454', colRun = '#ff7038';
const cAmber = new THREE.Color(0xffb454), cHot = new THREE.Color(0xff7038), cLed = new THREE.Color();

function tick(){
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);
  simT += dt;
  const t = simT % 10;
  const w = computeWeights(t);
  blend(w);

  gaitPhase += P.freq * TAU * dt;
  const p = gaitPhase, sn = Math.sin(p);
  const breathe = Math.sin(simT*1.5);

  // legs
  legL.hip.rotation.x = P.m - P.A*Math.sin(p);
  legL.knee.rotation.x = sampleKeys(kK, p);
  legL.ankle.rotation.x = sampleKeys(kF, p);
  const p2 = p + Math.PI;
  legR.hip.rotation.x = P.m - P.A*Math.sin(p2);
  legR.knee.rotation.x = sampleKeys(kK, p2);
  legR.ankle.rotation.x = sampleKeys(kF, p2);

  // arms
  armL.sh.rotation.x = P.armM + P.armA*sn + 0.012*breathe*w.wI;
  armR.sh.rotation.x = P.armM - P.armA*sn + 0.012*breathe*w.wI;
  armL.sh.rotation.z = -P.splay;  armR.sh.rotation.z = P.splay;
  armL.el.rotation.x = -(P.elbB + P.elbP*Math.max(0,-sn));
  armR.el.rotation.x = -(P.elbB + P.elbP*Math.max(0, sn));

  // torso / head
  spine.rotation.x = P.lean + 0.015*breathe*w.wI;
  spine.rotation.y = P.spTw*sn;
  hips.rotation.y = -P.hipTw*sn;
  headP.rotation.x = -P.lean*0.55;
  headP.rotation.y = -P.spTw*0.6*sn;

  // root
  fig.position.y = BELT_TOP + P.bobB + P.bobO*Math.cos(2*p) + 0.006*breathe*w.wI;
  fig.position.x = P.sway*Math.cos(p) + 0.006*Math.sin(simT*0.55)*w.wI;

  // belt
  const beltV = P.belt;
  if(beltV>1e-4){ beltOffset += beltV*dt; if(beltOffset>=SPACING) beltOffset%=SPACING; layoutBelt(); }
  for(const r of rollers) r.rotation.x -= beltV/0.068*dt;

  // console leds
  const norm = Math.min(1, beltV/2.3);
  const lit = 1 + Math.round(9*norm);
  cLed.copy(cAmber).lerp(cHot, norm);
  ledOn.color.copy(cLed);
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++) leds[i].material = i<lit ? ledOn : ledOff;

  // hud
  const mode = w.wR>0.5 ? 'RUN' : w.wW>0.5 ? 'WALK' : 'IDLE';
  if(mode!==hudMode){
    hudMode = mode; hud.mode.textContent = mode;
    hud.mode.style.color = mode==='RUN'?colRun : mode==='WALK'?colWalk : colIdle;
    drawScreen(mode, beltV); drawGauge(beltV, mode);
  }
  const spdTxt = beltV.toFixed(1);
  if(spdTxt!==hudSpd){ hudSpd=spdTxt; hud.spd.textContent = spdTxt+' m/s'; }
  hud.fill.style.transform = 'scaleX('+(t/10).toFixed(4)+')';

  // gauge refresh (needle moves smoothly)
  gaugeAcc += dt;
  if(gaugeAcc > 0.05){ gaugeAcc = 0; drawGauge(beltV, mode); drawScreen(mode, beltV); }

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
```
